faqs.question: What is Eagles Unbound?
faqs.answer: Eagles Unbound is an outdoor adventure and experiential learning destination off Kanakapura Road in South Bengaluru. Published programmes include corporate, student and adventure experiences.

faqs.question: Is this an official military training programme?
faqs.answer: No. The military-inspired concept is a civilian recreational adventure experience. It does not provide military service training, official armed-forces affiliation or military certification.

faqs.question: Can corporate and student groups enquire?
faqs.answer: Yes. Corporate Unbound and Students Unbound are existing programmes. Tell the team about your group, interests and preferred date to discuss suitable arrangements.

faqs.question: How do I request a booking?
faqs.answer: Use the booking request form to choose a published programme and preferred date, then share your group and contact details. A saved request receives a reference and remains Pending until the team confirms it.

faqs.question: Can I request a preferred date?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your preferred date is part of the request. It is subject to availability and team confirmation. Dates blocked by the team cannot be requested.

faqs.question: What should participants bring?
faqs.answer: Ask the team for the current clothing, footwear and equipment guidance for your selected experience. Confirm participation requirements and any access needs before visiting.

faqs.question: Which activities are available?
faqs.answer: The published library includes obstacle activities, rope courses, wall climbing, zip line, archery, air rifle shooting, team tasks, trekking and camping. Confirm current availability and programme inclusions with the team.

about.title: THE SPIRIT OF ADVENTURE.
about.intro: Outdoor experiences, shared challenges and opportunities to learn at Eagles Unbound.

sections.heading: OUR STORY
sections.body: Eagles Unbound is an outdoor adventure and experiential learning destination in the Kanakapura Road region of South Bengaluru. It brings together corporate groups, students, families and other visitors through adventure and time outdoors.

sections.heading: OUR VISION
sections.body: To create opportunities to discover strength, confidence and leadership through outdoor experiences.

sections.heading: OUR MISSION
sections.body: Adventure, learning, personal growth, leadership, teamwork and a connection with nature.

sections.heading: OUR VALUES
sections.body: Courage. Discipline. Teamwork. Resilience. Leadership. Confidence. Respect. Responsibility.

sections.heading: OUR APPROACH
sections.body: Programmes combine outdoor challenges, experiential learning, recreation and teamwork. The activity mix, participant suitability and final arrangements are confirmed for each group.

sections.heading: OUR LEADERSHIP
sections.body: Maj Gen V. P. S. Bhakuni, VSM (Retd.) is identified as Founder and CEO in the supplied business information. Visit the leadership page for the profile as it is prepared for publication.

founder.title: LEADERSHIP. WITH PURPOSE.
founder.intro: Meet the leadership behind Eagles Unbound.

sections.heading: MAJ GEN V. P. S. BHAKUNI, VSM (RETD.)
sections.body: Founder and CEO, as identified in the supplied business information. The extended biography, service highlights and official portrait will be published after client approval.

sections.heading: A SHARED PHILOSOPHY
sections.body: The business brings together adventure, experiential learning, discipline, courage and teamwork. Speak to the team about how these values inform your group experience.

kids-experiences.title: LITTLE EXPLORERS. BIG ADVENTURES.
kids-experiences.intro: Outdoor, creative and farm-based experiences to discuss for children and school groups.

sections.heading: PLAY. CREATE. DISCOVER.
sections.body: The supplied activity information includes kids zip line, low ropes, mud obstacles, soft archery and tractor rides. Suitability, age requirements and availability must be confirmed for each child or group.

sections.heading: HANDS-ON LEARNING
sections.body: Explore pottery, clay modelling, planters, seed balls, kitchen gardening, composting and nature-based learning. Ask which creative and farm activities can be included in your visit.

sections.heading: PLAN WITH THE TEAM
sections.body: Tell us the age range, group size and any access or dietary requirements. Confirm the programme and participation guidance before travelling.

schools-and-colleges.title: LEARNING. OUT IN THE OPEN.
schools-and-colleges.intro: Programme conversations for schools, colleges, teachers and coordinators.

sections.heading: SCHOOLS
sections.body: Explore School Day Outing and Outbound Student Activities. Discuss outdoor learning, creative and farm experiences, team challenges and the needs of your students.

sections.heading: COLLEGES
sections.body: Explore the College Adventure Program: a conversation about leadership, communication, collaboration and military-inspired civilian challenges.

sections.heading: YOUR INSTITUTION. YOUR PLAN.
sections.body: Share the student age range, organisation, preferred date, group size and meal preferences. Activities, menus, eligibility and the final schedule are confirmed with the team.

corporate.title: BUILD STRONGER TEAMS. BEYOND THE OFFICE.
corporate.intro: Outdoor experiences for employees, HR teams, leadership groups and organisations.

sections.heading: A SHARED CHALLENGE
sections.body: Discuss team bonding, communication, collaboration, trust, problem-solving and employee engagement through outdoor experiences.

sections.heading: TAILORED TO YOUR GROUP
sections.body: The supplied programme information includes obstacle and rope activities, group challenges, tug of war, mind games and outdoor recreation. The team will discuss the right mix and current availability.

sections.heading: START WITH A CONVERSATION
sections.body: Tell us your organisation, group size, objectives, preferred date and meal preferences. Request a programme discussion without an online payment or an implied confirmed reservation.

accommodation.title: STAY FOR THE OUTDOORS.
accommodation.intro: Discuss camping and overnight arrangements with the Eagles Unbound team.

sections.heading: CAMPING EXPERIENCES
sections.body: The supplied programme information includes tent pitching, night camping, campfire activities, sunrise hiking and time in nature. Confirm availability and the programme format before making arrangements.

sections.heading: TENTS AND GUEST ROOMS
sections.body: Ask the team about currently available accommodation, room and tent types, washrooms, accessibility and group arrangements. Detailed facilities and original accommodation photography are awaiting verification.

sections.heading: PLAN YOUR STAY
sections.body: Explore the Overnight Stay Program and discuss your group, meals and any special requirements. The final itinerary and accommodation arrangements require team confirmation.

food-and-dining.title: GOOD FOOD. GREAT COMPANY.
food-and-dining.intro: Meal planning for your selected experience. Menus and inclusions are confirmed with the team.

sections.heading: A MENU FOR YOUR PROGRAMME
sections.body: Breakfast, lunch, hi-tea and dinner arrangements vary by programme. Not every meal or dish is included in every experience.

sections.heading: TELL US WHAT YOUR GROUP NEEDS
sections.body: Share vegetarian and non-vegetarian meal counts and any dietary requirements in your enquiry. Discuss allergies and specific needs directly with the team before booking.
